title: RefundOptionResponse
description: A response detailing all refundable options for an order

optionIdsThatCanBePerformedTogether.description: A set of option ids that are possible to refund together. If only one option is returned, this will be empty. Ids are only valid inside the scope of a RefundOptionResponse

options.description: All the refundable options for a given order, or options for requested order lines

AffectedPaymentTransaction.description: A composition of payment transaction data that is affected, including the amount that will be subtracted if used in a refund

amount.description: The amount that will be subtracted from the transaction if used in a refund

rrn.description: The Retrieval Reference Number for the affected transaction

specificType.description: If available, a more specific payment type

transactionId.description: The id of the payment transaction

AffectedPaymentTransaction.title: AffectedPaymentTransaction

OrderReference.description: Wrapper detailing a OrderReference to an instance
OrderReference.title: OrderReference

ProductElementIdentifier.description: A type for depicting where an element resides in a sales package tree

fareStructureElementIndex.description: The index of the element on the farestructure element level

fareproductIndex.description: The index of the element on the fareproduct level

validableElementIndex.description: The index of the element on the validable element level

ProductElementIdentifier.title: ProductElementIdentifier

ProductsElementWrapper.description: A data-wrapper for a product type

id.description: The id of the product type

name.description: The name of the product type

version.description: The version of the product type

ProductsElementWrapper.title: ProductsElementWrapper

RefundOption.description: A representation of a complete refundable option

additionalAffectedElementsOnLevel.description: An optional list of additional elements on the same product level that this option also will consume

affectedPaymentTransactions.description: A summary list of which payment and its transactions that will be affected if this option is selected

expiresAt.description: The datetime that this option will expire

fee.description: The fee this option will entail. This needs to be subtracted from refundAmount to get the final amount that will be refunded

refundAmount.description: The refundable amount that this option permits

transientId.description: An id for an option that is unique only in the context of a RefundOptionResponse

RefundOption.title: RefundOption
